scope: Data-only fixture obligations, not a second roadmap; live task status remains tasks/backlog.md. No consumer implementation is modified.
evidence_level: Verified source behavior and signatures; no v5 behavioral acceptance executed. Source hashes bind evidence to actual content; repository commit identifies checked-out revision.

boundaries.rho: values, preservation, graph components, storage, native exact access, certified cuts and complete changes
boundaries.sigma: adapter, IR, relational and temporal execution, inference, solver and computation progress
boundaries.ai_soc: source semantics, materialization and product parity

current_v4_source_delta.evidence_level: Upstream source contracts only; no merged-source compilation, behavior, migration or performance acceptance. Historical consumer/source pins are unchanged.
current_v4_source_delta.qualification: V6 must rerun its previously v4.50.1-qualified reader preflight against this reader; root aggregate and hosted gates remain separate.
current_v4_source_delta.dependencies: No go.mod/go.sum, nested v5 module, comparator module or workflow dependency changes in this upstream delta.

obligations.required_v5_mapping: Preserve estimated NDV and current indexable-scalar presence Count separately from exact Min/Max. HLL NDV is non-decreasing across deletes until rebuild. The NDV-only door must not force an extreme-value rescan. v4 node capability: memory/badger/tiered; relationship: memory/badger; disabled or unsupported statistics return ErrCapabilityNotSupported, never substitute zero.
required_tests: After deleting the maximum, NDV/Count agree with PropertyStats at a stable moment without invoking its Min/Max rescan.
Node/relationship mirrors, unknown pairs, disabled/unsupported capabilities, nil/closed wrappers and errors.Is propagation.
obligations.ownership: rho access/statistics contract; sigma adapter and planner consumption

obligations.required_v5_mapping: Count relationship identities with history, including deleted identities, not history rows/versions. v4 memory/badger answer in O(relationships with history); sharded/tiered/external decline. Type reuse by ID may overcount per type, so supported zero safely means none; decline must not justify a no-history optimization.
required_tests: Update/close/delete one type while another remains without history; compare identity sets and distinguish supported zero from decline.
Reused ID across types remains a conservative upper bound; retention/clear/reopen refresh the answer.
obligations.ownership: rho access/statistics contract; sigma adapter and planner consumption

obligations.required_v5_mapping: An empty intersection of known labels is served (ok=true, no callbacks) on all four stores, rather than declined. Unknown labels and unsupported/over-cap shapes retain decline. Snapshot generations require the usual post-read mutation-epoch check; emptiness does not establish cut or source completeness.

evidence.anchor: An empty intersection of known labels

required_tests: Disjoint known labels, then member joins/leaves, unknown label, callback count and epoch checks across memory/badger/sharded/tiered.
obligations.ownership: rho access/statistics contract; sigma adapter and planner consumption

obligations.required_v5_mapping: Unindexed temporal property seeks may restrict history candidates to ever-members of the label/type and prune acquisition strictly after the effective pin. Current matches are united; exact version resolution remains authoritative. Never filter by current label alone. Missing/unsafe capability and depth-scoped stores keep the full-history fallback.
required_tests: Historical label loss/acquisition, property change and deleted relationships: exact sets at point/window/pin, including predicate held only earlier in interval.
Named/generic node/relationship doors equal independent history resolution; unrelated-label/type history does not cause chain loads on answering capabilities.
obligations.ownership: rho access/statistics contract; sigma adapter and planner consumption

obligations.required_v5_mapping: Pure valid-time adjacency may answer a proven history-free live row directly; transaction pins, unknown history, deleted rows and history-bearing rows keep full resolution and watermark checks. Preserve half-open bounds, mint fallback only for v4 unset values, direction/type predicates, sorted relationship IDs, owned callback isolation and stored endpoint ordinals. Memory unfiltered/unpaged column scans may reuse sorted membership; filtered/paged and segment doors retain their proper paths.
required_tests: Compare both adjacency doors/directions at every point/window bound and transaction pin to full chain resolution after update/delete/retract.
Row/column IDs, property kinds, endpoint ordinals, cancellation/early stop and wrapper overrides agree across small/large sets, membership churn, segments and paging.
obligations.ownership: rho access/statistics contract; sigma adapter and planner consumption

obligations.required_v5_mapping: A cached column snapshot is immutable: an in-place write patches typed values, dictionaries, validity and affected zone blocks; new members append; removal/class change/unbalanced records rebuild. Held old snapshots stay unchanged. RelTypeDegreeStats may cache by per-type stripe plus coarse invalidation; collisions may over-invalidate. Global relationship epoch still moves for every relationship mutation, and v4 memory relationship columns still use it. Neither epoch is a database cut.
required_tests: Random insert/update/remove/relabel sequences compare patched single/intersection columns and held old snapshots against independent full rebuild, including numeric type transitions/string dictionary/validity.
Own-type, other-type, stripe collision and coarse mutation doors invalidate the intended degree cache; global Gate-2 epochs remain safe under concurrent writes.
